text_block_list.text:
One day, while strolling through the 
shopping district……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, what should I do here~? Shrimp, 
kakiage, squid, green peppers...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, you see, the old guy at the 
shopping district said he'd give me a huge 
pile of tempura.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm genuinely happy and seriously 
grateful, but there's no way in hell I can 
finish all of this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because if you eat fried food all at once, 
your stomach will get upset... right?
choice_data_list:
Pick up the eating pace with grated 
daikon!
Let's throw a tempura party in the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Grated daikon radish~? How is that gonna 
help pick up the pace?
choice_data_list: Great for relieving an upset stomach!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh~ Like old-school grandmotherly wisdom? 
I kinda like that stuff.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, an old lady 
once taught me how to use leftover 
tempura.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to buy a daikon from the 
greengrocer! And then, I'll eat just as 
much as I want.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In the dorm? ...Ah, leaving it in the 
cafeteria should work nicely.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That way, anyone who wants some can just 
help themselves, even if I don't say 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It'll also help promote the shopping 
district's delicious tempura. Yeah... 
let's go with that~.
